--challenge-ttl.help: how long a generated challenge password stays valid

--check.help: Run in check mode (default if no flag is provided)

--checkin.help: enable separate HTTP endpoint for MDM check-ins

--cis-dir.help: Override the CIS directory path. By default, resolved from the repo root as ee/cis/macos-{version}/. Use this if running from outside the repo or testing a custom policy set.

--cisa-known-exploit.help: Whether CISA reported it as a known exploit

--cleanup.help: Delete the Fleet team, the enrolled host record, and the tart VM after the run. Without this flag, the team and host remain in Fleet for inspection (the VM is still deleted unless --keep-vm is also set).

--cleanup_teams.help: Removes teams from previous runs and exits

--command.help: the supported command to execute, if not providing profile-uuid or serial-number.

--common_software_count.help: Number of common installed applications reported to fleet

--common_software_name_suffix.help: Suffix to add to generated common software names

--common_software_uninstall_count.help: Number of common software to uninstall

--common_vscode_extensions_software_unin.help: Number of common vscode_extensions software to uninstall

--content.help: Content of the script to execute.

--crtvalid.help: validity for new client certificates in days

--csrverifierexec.help: will be passed the CSRs for verification

--cve.help: The CVE to create a Jira issue for

--dm.help: URL to send Declarative Management requests to

--dnsname.help: DNS name to be included in the certificate (SAN)

--dry-run.help: Log what would be assigned without making any changes in Fleet.

--dump.help: dump MDM requests and responses to stdout

--duplicate_bundle_identifiers_percent.help: Percentage of software with duplicate bundle identifiers (0-100)

--entity-ids.help: comma-separated entity IDs (default: '' for non-entity datasets)

--exec-id.help: Execution ID of the script, will be auto-generated if empty.

--failing-policy-team-id.help: The Team ID of the failing policy

--filter-labels.help: Comma-separated list of labels; only issues containing ALL of these labels are included (case-insensitive). Example: 'story,customer-numa'.

--fleet-token.help: Fleet API token for authenticated API calls (team creation, host lookup, profile push, cleanup). Resolution order: this flag, then $FLEET_API_TOKEN, then the token from the fleetctl config file. To populate the config file, run: fleetctl login

--hosts-count.help: The number of hosts to match the CVE or failing policy

--idp-dsn.help: MySQL DSN for the IDP seeder (default fleet:insecure@tcp(localhost:3306)/fleet)

--idp-user-count.help: Seed N users with IDP accounts via direct MySQL (0 = skip)

--keep-vm.help: Do not delete the tart VM after the run, and reuse it on subsequent runs. If a VM with the same name already exists and is reachable, the tool skips creation and enrollment entirely, saving several minutes. Useful for iterating on tests. By default the VM is deleted when tests finish.

--key-encipherment-selector.help: Filter CA certificates by key encipherment usage

--node_key_file.help: File with node keys to use

--only-mdm.help: Only run MDM-dependent tests (PROFILE and ORG_DECISION). Skip script-based and manual tests. Useful when validating MDM profile delivery.

--only-scripts.help: Only run script-based tests (PASS_FAIL and PASS_ONLY). Skip MDM profile tests, org-decision tests, and manual prompts. Useful for running a fast, fully-automated subset.

--only_already_enrolled.help: Only start agents that are already enrolled

--password.help: password to encrypt/decrypt private key with

--path.help: File path of the custom package (or a directory of packages)

WARNING: the pre-built package contains a baked-in enroll secret that may not match the test team this tool creates. The VM may enroll into a different team or fail to enroll. Only use this if you know the package was built with the correct secret.

--pkg-url.help: URL where the package will be served

--platform.help: Platform to process: ubuntu or rhel

--port.help: http port to listen on (if you want to specify an address, use -http-addr instead)

--premium.help: Whether to simulate a premium user or not

--profile-uuid.help: the Apple profile UUID to retrieve

--run.help: Skip the confirm prompt and run osquery-perf immediately

--scripts-disabled.help: Disable execution of scripts on the host.

--secret_variable.help: Generate profiles and scripts with a given secret variable

--seed.help: Seed Fleet with standard saved queries and exit

--serial-number.help: serial number of a device to get the device details

--server-private-key.help: fleet server's private key (to decrypt MDM assets)

--server_url.help: URL (with protocol and port of osquery server)

--sign-server-attrs.help: sign cert attrs for server usage

--skip-no-script.help: Skip MANUAL-type tests (policies with no automation) instead of prompting the user to perform the steps. MDM profile tests and org-decision tests still run. (--skip-no-script is kept as a deprecated alias.)

--socket.help: Path to the extensions UNIX domain socket

--software_db_path.help: Path to software.db (SQLite database with realistic software data). Auto-generates from software.sql if missing.

--software_renaming.help: Enable software renaming for duplicate bundle identifiers

--source-migration.help: Name of the source migration file to bump (required).

--start-date.help: start date (YYYY-MM-DD), defaults to now - days

--start_period.help: Duration to spread start of hosts over

--strip-emojis.help: Strip emojis from project titles and statuses

--team.help: **Available in Fleet Premium.** Only output the configuration files of the fleet with the specified name. Global or "Unassigned" configuration may be output using `--team global` or `--team no-team`.

--ubuntu.help: Number of Ubuntu software rows to insert

--unenroll.help: Unenroll from MDM instead of enrolling

--unique_software_count.help: Number of unique software installed on each host

--unique_software_uninstall_count.help: Number of unique software to uninstall

--unique_user_count.help: Number of unique host users reported to fleet

--unique_vscode_extensions_software_coun.help: Number of unique vscode_extensions software installed on each host

--unique_vscode_extensions_software_unin.help: Number of unique vscode_extensions software to uninstall

--update.help: Update the generated files with the current cacheable items

--validity-days.help: validity period in days for issued certificates
